''Briseus''' and '''Esmond''' can be found in the [[Everfrost Cavern]] after completing {{Quest|The Star That Voyages Far}}. 

They're originally from New Federation and sent under order of someone to escort a pair of researchers.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Briseus:''' The Void Storm appeared out of nowhere and tore this place apart before anyone even noticed… This is way too dangerous.

:'''Briseus:''' I don't want to be here. When can we leave?

:'''Esmond:''' Right after the two we've been escorting finish collecting the data.

:'''Briseus:''' Fine. Heh, this job's a real pain. Those researchers have a talent for getting themselves into trouble.

:'''Briseus:''' Babysitting these naive blokes, or doing dirty work back in the New Fed... hard to say which is worse.

:'''Briseus:''' Sometimes I swear these "scientists" are all unhinged. No sane person would come all the way out here just to study the Threnodian.

:'''Esmond:''' If it weren't for Mr. [[Chase]] backing the business prospects here, our boss never would've sent us all the way from the New Fed.

:'''Esmond:''' It's just a job. Same as any other.

:'''Briseus:''' Mr. Chase, huh… I've heard of him. Got a knack for big games. Boss might want to join his table, but folks like him usually play everyone else.

:'''Esmond:''' If that happens, we'll just find someone else to work for.

:'''Esmond:''' Like I said, Briseus, it's only a job. Doesn't mean all that much to people like us.
{{Dialogue End}}
